title: AUDIT.redactions (audit.redactions.v1)
description: Story 3.1 append-only SIEM projection of a single redacted field (FR41/FR44). AUTHORITATIVE validation source for AUDIT.redactions; redactions.yaml is the human-readable mirror. Records that a field at field_path was redacted for reason, NEVER the secret value that was redacted (NFR18). redacted_at (the redaction decision time) is distinct from published_at (the audit-emission time). Story 4.5 (FR44/NFR15 persistence boundary) ADDS the optional source (the report region a persistence-bound redaction fired in) and incident_id discriminators; both are additive-optional, so audit.redactions.v1 is unchanged and the Story 3.1 LLM-bound producers stay byte-identical (empty source is treated as evidence).
